benefits.name: Comprehensive Health Benefits
benefits.details:
We’ve got you covered! All InMobians have access to excellent healthcare choices.
1. This includes family/ group medical cover in times of unforeseen emergencies for you, your partner (irrespective of marital status or gender), 2 children, parents and parents-in-law
2. OPD expenses in case of accidents
3. Dental, Eye and Physiotherapy cover

benefits.name: Physical & Emotional Well-being
benefits.details:
Eat healthy, live healthy!
1. Delightful and scrumptious buffets with our nutritious wide-spread salad bar and well-balanced meals
2. 24/7 snack & juice counters
3. Unlimited counselling services on our Employee Assistance Platform
4. Regular yoga sessions and a dedicated onsite gym trainer
5. Wellness reimbursement allowance for gym memberships, wellness classes/activities.

benefits.name: Time-off
benefits.details:
Your child deserves the best!
1. Paid flexible gender-neutral parental leave of up to 7 months to cover not just childbirth but also adoption, surrogacy and premature childbirth
2. Access to premium child day care services at reasonable rates through InMobi’s partnership with KLAY
3. Fun filled and educative summer camp programme for InMobi kids

benefits.name: Other Awesome Perks
benefits.details:
Happiness, you can’t ignore!
1. In-house concierge services to get those long pending chores out of the way
2. Competitive EAP packages which provide free or discounted services on estate planning, legal assistance, financial advising
3. Nap rooms to release stress
4. Salary advance benefit, at zero interest
5. Pet friendly workplace. We love having our furry friends pay us a visit and spread their love
